t: the store is asking for many images, should we use the same resources as original xchat or might that be confusing

Advised against reusing xChat identity assets (store flags listing confusion; users could not tell the items apart) — OpenSession branding for identity, while reusing upstream product screenshot of the DM UI is fine since the fork ships that functionality. Built the pack in xChatHub/docs/store: 128px store icon + extension toolbar icons regenerated from the OpenSession mark, and four live 1280x800 screenshots captured headlessly (Playwright against production with injected token): feed, Slack session view showing the v0.4 channel rail live, thread-create form, chat roster. Screenshot QA caught a missing header gap (Contributors2-on-X) — fixed, redeployed, retaken. Release zip rebuilt with new icons and re-uploaded to the opensession-xchat-0.0.3 release.
